business_problem: Best Buy is transforming its retail experience. The company aims to bring the quality personal service of its physical stores to digital and voice channels, so customers can purchase with confidence and quickly get help if they need it.
solution_summary: Best Buy deployed Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience to use AI to enable seamless customer journeys from purchase through to support. The platform allows internal Best Buy teams to build conversational voice and chat agents that bypass legacy text-to-speech processing layers, making conversations feel more natural. CX Agent Studio makes it faster and easier to deploy the AI agents and cuts traditional 18-month software development timelines to 3-6 weeks. Underpinning the environment is Gemini Flash, a voice-native audio model that drives Best Buy's automated computer troubleshooting experience. Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience enables Best Buy to achieve two critical goals: deliver self-service to callers and support customers who need to speak to a person by ensuring they have the necessary background to quickly assist them.
